title: Tinker Slashes AI Prices Up to 70% Following Efficiency Gains
summary:
The launch of GLM-5.3-Flash and DeepSeek-v4.1-Flash introduces native image input support and efficient attention architecture to the Tinker API. These new models are designed for cost-efficient long-context workloads and arrive alongside updated long-context options for Qwen3.5-4B and Qwen3.6-35B-A3B.

Tinker reduced its API pricing by as much as 70% across its platform after scaling efficiency improvements for long-context reinforcement learning. As part of these changes, the GLM-5.3-Flash model is now 4 to 5 times less expensive for users than the standard GLM-5.3 version.
